author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Como marked its first Champions League match with a 4-1 victory over RB Leipzig, delivering the night’s standout result after a rapid effort to bring its stadium up to competition standards.

The Italian club entered the tournament as a newcomer and immediately converted the occasion into a decisive win. Its debut added another unexpected chapter to a round that also featured strong starts from established powers.

Manchester United beat Sabah 4-0, while Bayern Munich defeated Bodo/Glimt 5-0. Bayern’s victory extended its run of winning Champions League opening matches to 23 consecutive campaigns. Roma and Fenerbahce drew 1-1 in another of Thursday’s fixtures.

Sabah also made history by fielding a starting lineup containing players from 11 different nationalities, according to Reuters. For Como, however, the scoreline supplied the clearest statement: a club that had been racing to prepare its venue looked fully ready on the field. The result gives Como an early platform in the competition, though the league phase will demand sustained performances against a wider range of opponents.
dek: The Italian newcomer beat RB Leipzig after racing to upgrade its stadium, while Manchester United and Bayern Munich also posted convincing wins.
headline: Como wins 4-1 in dream Champions League debut
